entry.name: mc.phasegroove~
entry.description: The phasegroove~ object converts ramps between 0 and 1 into a sample-increment signal that you can use to control the groove~ object. phasegroove~ must be connected to a groove~. Once connected, it knows about the groove~ object's loop points and the sample it is playing.
